preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s contains only lowercase alphabetic characters.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output is the omeric string formed by concatenating the longest palindromic suffix with the longest palindromic prefix of the input string.
The second line of the output is a list of integers representing the frequency of each prefix in the omeric string.
